entry.title: Deadwood Dominicana Cigarillos — Tin of 10
entry.summaryHtml: Honey, cream, cocoa, sweet fig, hay, earth and buttery sweetness define this compact Dominican-forward Deadwood. The Connecticut Shade wrapper and sweetened cap keep the 4″ × 32 cigarillo soft and aromatic, while the Mexican San Andrés binder adds enough earth and cocoa to stop the profile becoming purely sugary.
entry.noteHtml: This is the cigarillo expression of Drew Estate’s first Dominican-focused Deadwood blend: a smoother, more traditional direction than the darker original Deadwood sisters, while retaining the line’s signature sweetened cap.
productionLines: Made in Nicaragua at La Gran Fabrica Drew Estate
